items.t: SpaceX’s Big Day: A Historic Starship Launch, a Tesla Merger Under Scrutiny, and a $74 Billion AI Bet
items.sum: SpaceX is preparing to try catching both Starship stages with its launch tower, right after announcing more than $74 billion in new AI campuses, but a possible Tesla merger now has a skeptic in Texas’ incoming attorney general.

items.t: Tesla and SpaceX Move Closer to a Deal. What Would Tesla Shareholders Get?

items.t: Texas AG-elect vows 'tremendous scrutiny' of SpaceX-Tesla merger
items.sum: Investors widely expect Musk to combine SpaceX and Tesla, possibly by December. Texas’ next attorney general says that deserves a hard look.

items.t: General Motors vs. Tesla: Which Is the Better Automotive Stock to Buy Going Into 2027?
items.sum: GM trades at 6.4x forward earnings while Tesla commands 236.8x, yet only one carries a debt-to-equity ratio near 2.1x. The gap raises a question about which risk investors are really paying for.
